checks.name: still_a_checklist
checks.detail: the checklist was turned into a table

answer:
I rebuilt the Lisbon packing page so it works with VoiceOver, and it can now add items. You'll find it under Page in the note. I haven't opened it in the app or tried it with VoiceOver.

**Accessibility**
- Each item is a real checkbox with its name as the label. VoiceOver reads it as "Passport, checkbox, unchecked".
- Clothes, Documents, Tech and Other are headings, so your partner can jump between them. Each heading says how many items are packed, for example "2 of 4 packed".
- The page announces results, such as "Passport packed" or an error message. Focus stays on the item you just ticked or on the add field.
- The add field has a visible label and a text "Add item" button. The old icon-only button had no label.
- Every control is at least 44 px tall. Packed items are crossed out, but the checkbox state tells you too. The page now uses the app's colours, so dark mode works.

**Adding items**
A page can't add checklist lines, only table rows. I added a small "Other" table at the end of the note, with Item and Packed columns. Anything added on the page goes there and shows up as a checkbox you can tick. Your original checklist items are unchanged.
